summary: Defines how to use Address Family Identifier 17, Distinguished Name, in LISP. LISP has Endpoint Identifiers and Routing Locators, and names can appear in either type of record in control messages to convey extra information.

eli5.summary: Network addresses are usually numbers. This lets a text name sit in the address slot of certain messages, to carry extra information.

questions: how to use names in lisp eid records
